name: Acid Splash
desc: One or two creatures within 5 ft. of each other; Con save or 1d6 acid (2d6 at 5th, 3d6 at 11th, 4d6 at 17th).

name: Blade Ward
desc: Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from weapon attacks until end of next turn.

name: Chill Touch
desc: Ranged spell attack; 1d8 necrotic (scales at 5/11/17th). Hit creature can't regain HP until start of your next turn. On undead: also disadvantage on attacks against you.

name: Dancing Lights
materials: a bit of phosphorus or wychwood, or a glowworm
desc: Create up to 4 torch-sized lights within 120 ft. Each round, bonus action to move them 60 ft.

name: Druidcraft
desc: Minor nature effects: predict weather, cause plants to bloom, create a tiny flame, or sensory effect.

name: Eldritch Blast
desc: Ranged spell attack: 1d10 force. Extra beams at 5th (2), 11th (3), 17th (4). Each beam can target separately.

name: Fire Bolt
desc: Ranged spell attack; 1d10 fire (2d10 at 5th, 3d10 at 11th, 4d10 at 17th). Ignites flammable objects.

name: Friends
materials: a small amount of makeup applied to the face
desc: Advantage on Cha checks against one non-hostile creature. Creature may become hostile after spell ends.

name: Guidance
desc: Touch willing creature; once before spell ends they add 1d4 to an ability check.

name: Light
materials: a firefly or phosphorescent moss
desc: Object up to 10 ft. sheds bright light 20 ft. and dim 20 ft. more. Dex save for hostile creature holding it.

name: Mage Hand
desc: Spectral floating hand; carry up to 10 lb., manipulate objects, open/close doors, retrieve items. Not attack or spells.

name: Mending
materials: two lodestones
desc: Repair a single break or tear in an object, leaving no trace. Doesn't restore magic to a magic item.

name: Message
materials: a short piece of copper wire
desc: Whisper a message to one creature; it can reply. Not heard by others. Passes through barriers with Perception penalties.

name: Minor Illusion
materials: a bit of fleece
desc: Create sound or image within a 5-ft. cube. Investigation check vs. spell save DC to disbelieve.

name: Poison Spray
desc: Puff of toxic gas; Con save or 1d12 poison (scales at 5/11/17th).

name: Prestidigitation
desc: Minor magical tricks: soil or clean, light/snuff flame, chill/warm/flavor 1 cu. ft., color/mark, trinket/illusory image, symbol, sensory effect.

name: Produce Flame
desc: Flame in hand; sheds light 10 ft. bright, 10 ft. dim. Can hurl as bonus action: ranged spell attack, 1d8 fire (scales at 5/11/17th).

name: Ray of Frost
desc: Ranged spell attack; 1d8 cold (scales at 5/11/17th). Hit: speed reduced 10 ft. until start of your next turn.

name: Resistance
materials: a miniature cloak
desc: Touched willing creature adds 1d4 to one saving throw before spell ends.

name: Sacred Flame
desc: Dex save (no cover benefit) or 1d8 radiant (scales at 5/11/17th).

name: Shillelagh
materials: mistletoe, a shamrock leaf, and a club or quarterstaff
desc: Club/quarterstaff becomes magical; use Wis for attack/damage rolls; 1d8 damage.

name: Shocking Grasp
desc: Melee spell attack (adv. if target wears metal armor); 1d8 lightning (scales at 5/11/17th). Target can't take reactions until start of its next turn.

name: Spare the Dying
desc: Touch creature with 0 HP; it becomes stable. No effect on undead or constructs.

name: Thaumaturgy
desc: Minor divine miracle: tremor, change flame, thunder sound, extinguish/create flame, change eye color, open/close door, alter voice.

name: Thorn Whip
materials: the stem of a plant with thorns
desc: Melee spell attack; 1d6 piercing (scales at 5/11/17th). Pull Large or smaller target 10 ft. toward you.

name: True Strike
desc: Concentrate; on next turn, advantage on first attack roll against that creature.

name: Vicious Mockery
desc: Wis save or 1d4 psychic (scales at 5/11/17th) and disadvantage on next attack roll before end of its next turn.

name: Alarm
materials: a tiny bell and a piece of fine silver wire
desc: Set alarm against intrusion in 20-ft. cube. Mental or audible alarm when a Tiny or larger creature enters without your safe word.

name: Animal Friendship
materials: a morsel of food
desc: Wis save (if Int < 4) or beast is charmed by you for 24 hours. Higher slots: one additional beast per slot.

name: Bane
materials: a drop of blood
desc: Up to 3 creatures; Cha save or subtract 1d4 from attack rolls and saving throws. Higher slots: +1 target per slot.

name: Bless
materials: a sprinkling of holy water
desc: Up to 3 creatures; add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws. Higher slots: +1 target per slot.

name: Burning Hands
desc: 15-ft. cone; Dex save or 3d6 fire, half on save. Higher slots: +1d6 per slot.

name: Charm Person
desc: Humanoid; Wis save (adv. if in combat) or charmed until spell ends or you harm it. Higher slots: +1 target per slot.

name: Color Spray
materials: a pinch of powder or sand colored red, yellow, and blue
desc: 6d10 HP worth of creatures in a cone are blinded. Higher slots: +2d10 per slot.

name: Command
desc: One-word command; Wis save or obey. Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel, Halt. Higher slots: +1 target per slot.

name: Comprehend Languages
materials: a pinch of soot and salt
desc: Understand any spoken language and read written language (takes 1 minute per page).

name: Cure Wounds
desc: Touch creature regains 1d8 + spellcasting mod HP. Higher slots: +1d8 per slot. No effect on undead/constructs.

name: Detect Evil and Good
desc: Know if aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, fiend, or undead is within 30 ft. and know their type and direction.

name: Detect Magic
desc: Sense magic within 30 ft. See a faint aura around magical objects or creatures. Action to know which school of magic.

name: Detect Poison and Disease
materials: a yew leaf
desc: Sense presence and location of poisons, poisonous creatures, and diseases within 30 ft.

name: Disguise Self
desc: Change appearance: clothes, weapons, equipment, body features. Investigation check vs. spell save DC to see through.

name: Divine Favor
desc: Your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage on a hit.

name: Entangle
desc: 20-ft.-sq. of ground becomes difficult terrain. Str save or restrained. Creature can use action to repeat save.

name: Expeditious Retreat
desc: Dash as a bonus action on each of your turns.

name: Faerie Fire
desc: Objects and creatures in 20-ft. cube; Dex save or outlined in blue/green/violet light. Outlined: no invisibility benefit, attacks against them have advantage.

name: False Life
materials: a small amount of alcohol or distilled spirits
desc: Gain 1d4+4 temporary HP. Higher slots: +5 temp HP per slot.

name: Feather Fall
materials: a small feather or piece of down
desc: Up to 5 falling creatures slow to 60 ft./round. No falling damage if spell is active when they land.

name: Find Familiar
materials: 10 gp worth of charcoal, incense, and herbs consumed in fire
desc: Fey, fiend, or celestial spirit takes animal form as familiar. Telepathic bond within 100 ft. See through its eyes.

name: Fog Cloud
desc: 20-ft.-radius sphere of fog, heavily obscured. Higher slots: radius increases by 20 ft. per slot.

name: Goodberry
materials: a sprig of mistletoe
desc: Up to 10 magical berries; each restores 1 HP and provides sustenance for one day. Berries spoil after 24 hours.

name: Grease
materials: a bit of pork rind or butter
desc: 10-ft.-sq. slick grease; Dex save or fall prone. Difficult terrain for duration.

name: Guiding Bolt
desc: Ranged spell attack; 4d6 radiant. Next attack roll against target before end of your next turn has advantage. Higher slots: +1d6 per slot.

name: Healing Word
desc: Target regains 1d4 + spellcasting mod HP. Higher slots: +1d4 per slot. No effect on undead/constructs.

name: Hellish Rebuke
desc: Reaction when damaged; attacker makes Dex save or 2d10 fire, half on save. Higher slots: +1d10 per slot.

name: Heroism
desc: Willing creature immune to frightened and gains temporary HP equal to spellcasting mod at start of each turn. Higher slots: +1 target per slot.

name: Hex
materials: the petrified eye of a newt
desc: Curse target; deal extra 1d6 necrotic on each hit. Target has disadvantage on one ability check type. If target drops to 0, bonus action to move hex. Higher slots: duration extends (2nd=8h, 3rd+=24h).

name: Hideous Laughter
materials: tiny tarts and a feather
desc: Creature with Int > 4; Wis save or fall prone laughing (incapacitated). Int <= 4 is immune. Repeat save with adv. each turn when damaged.

name: Hunter's Mark
desc: Mark target; deal extra 1d6 on each hit. Adv. on Perception/Survival to find it. If drops to 0, bonus action to move mark. Higher slots: duration (2nd=8h, 3rd+=24h).

name: Identify
materials: a pearl worth at least 100 gp and an owl feather
desc: Learn magic item properties, attunement requirement, active spells on creature/object, and how to use them.

name: Inflict Wounds
desc: Melee spell attack; 3d10 necrotic. Higher slots: +1d10 per slot.

name: Jump
materials: a grasshopper's hind leg
desc: Touched creature's jump distance is tripled until spell ends.

name: Longstrider
materials: a pinch of dirt
desc: Touch creature; speed increases by 10 ft. Higher slots: +1 target per slot.

name: Mage Armor
materials: a piece of cured leather
desc: Willing creature not wearing armor has AC = 13 + Dex mod. Ends if creature dons armor.

name: Magic Missile
desc: 3 darts, each 1d4+1 force, automatically hit. Higher slots: +1 dart per slot.

name: Protection from Evil and Good
materials: holy water or powdered silver and iron
desc: Protect against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, undead: disadvantage on attacks against target, target immune to charm/frighten/possess.

name: Ray of Sickness
desc: Ranged spell attack; 2d8 poison. Hit: Con save or poisoned until end of your next turn. Higher slots: +1d8 per slot.

name: Sanctuary
materials: a small silver mirror
desc: Attackers must make Wis save to target the warded creature. Ends if warded creature attacks or casts a spell.

name: Shield
desc: Reaction when hit by attack or targeted by magic missile. +5 AC until start of next turn. Immune to magic missile.

name: Shield of Faith
materials: a small parchment with a bit of holy text
desc: Target gains +2 AC for the duration.

name: Sleep
materials: a pinch of fine sand, rose petals, or a cricket
desc: 5d8 HP worth of creatures in 20-ft. radius fall unconscious (lowest HP first). Undead/immune to charm unaffected. Higher slots: +2d8 per slot.

name: Speak with Animals
desc: Verbally communicate with beasts for duration. They may not be able to answer complex questions, but you can request favors.

name: Thunderwave
desc: 15-ft. cube; Con save or 2d8 thunder + pushed 10 ft. Half damage, not pushed on save. Loud boom heard 300 ft. Higher slots: +1d8 per slot.

name: Witch Bolt
materials: a twig from a tree that has been struck by lightning
desc: Ranged spell attack; 1d12 lightning. Action each turn to deal 1d12 automatic; ends if target is out of range or you use action differently. Higher slots: +1d12 per slot.

name: Aid
materials: a tiny strip of white cloth
desc: Up to 3 creatures; each gains 5 HP max and current HP. Higher slots: +5 HP per slot.

name: Alter Self
desc: Aquatic adaptation, change appearance, or natural weapons (1d6 + Str, magical).

name: Arcane Lock
materials: gold dust worth at least 25 gp
desc: Touch a closed door, window, or chest. Magically locked; DC to open increases by 10. You, designated creatures, and magic word bypass lock.

name: Barkskin
materials: a handful of oak bark
desc: Touch willing creature; AC can't be less than 16 for duration.

name: Blindness/Deafness
desc: Con save or blinded or deafened (your choice). Repeat save at end of each turn. Higher slots: +1 target per slot.

name: Blur
desc: Your form blurs; attackers have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. Creatures that don't rely on sight are unaffected.

name: Branding Smite
desc: Next hit also deals 2d6 radiant. Target becomes visible if invisible. Dim light 5 ft. Higher slots: +1d6 per slot.

name: Calm Emotions
desc: 20-ft.-radius; Cha save or either suppress charmed/frightened or make indifferent to hostile creatures (ends if attacked or harmed).

name: Darkness
materials: bat fur and a drop of pitch or piece of coal
desc: 15-ft.-radius sphere of magical darkness. No nonmagical or lower-level magical light penetrates. Blindsight functions normally.

name: Darkvision
materials: either a pinch of dried carrot or an agate
desc: Touch willing creature; gains darkvision 60 ft. for 8 hours (or extends existing darkvision to 60 ft.).

name: Detect Thoughts
materials: a copper piece
desc: Read surface thoughts of visible creatures within 30 ft. Wis save to probe deeper. Creature aware of probing on failed Int save.

name: Enhance Ability
materials: fur or a feather from a beast
desc: Bull's Strength (adv. Str, double carry), Cat's Grace (adv. Dex, no fall damage ≤20 ft), Bear's Endurance (adv. Con, 2d6 temp HP), Fox's Cunning (adv. Int), Owl's Wisdom (adv. Wis), Eagle's Splendor (adv. Cha). Higher slots: +1 target per slot.

name: Enlarge/Reduce
materials: a pinch of powdered iron
desc: Enlarge: target doubles in size, advantage on Str, +1d4 damage. Reduce: target halves in size, disadvantage on Str, -1d4 damage. Con save to resist.

name: Enthrall
desc: Wis save or distracted by your words; disadvantage on Perception to see others. Ends if you stop speaking.

name: Find Traps
desc: Learn presence (not location) of traps within range and line of sight.

name: Flaming Sphere
materials: a bit of tallow, a pinch of brimstone, and a dusting of powdered iron
desc: 5-ft.-diameter sphere of fire. Bonus action to move 30 ft. Creatures entering or starting adjacent: Dex save or 2d6 fire, half on save. Higher slots: +1d6 per slot.

name: Gust of Wind
materials: a legume seed
desc: 60-ft. line, 10 ft. wide. Creatures: Str save or pushed 15 ft. Moving against line costs double. Disperses gas/vapor in 20 ft.

name: Heat Metal
materials: a piece of iron and a flame
desc: Metal object or armor glows red-hot. Wielder/wearer takes 2d8 fire each turn you maintain. Bonus action to intensify. Creature in heated armor has disadvantage on attacks/checks. Higher slots: +1d8 per slot.

name: Hold Person
materials: a small, straight piece of iron
desc: Humanoid; Wis save or paralyzed. Repeat save at end of each turn. Higher slots: +1 target per slot.

name: Invisibility
materials: an eyelash encased in gum arabic
desc: Touch willing creature becomes invisible. Ends if creature attacks or casts a spell. Higher slots: +1 target per slot.

name: Knock
desc: Object bound by lock, Hold Portal, or Arcane Lock becomes unlocked/opened. Loud knock audible 300 ft.

name: Lesser Restoration
desc: End one disease, or end blindness, deafness, paralysis, or poison condition on target creature.

name: Levitate
materials: either a small leather loop or a piece of golden wire bent into a cup shape
desc: One creature or object (up to 500 lb.) rises or floats 20 ft. per round (move is free action). Can't move horizontally on own.

name: Locate Object
materials: a forked twig
desc: Sense direction of specific object within 1,000 ft. if familiar with it. Lead blocks this spell.

name: Magic Weapon
desc: Nonmagical weapon becomes +1 magic weapon. Higher slots: 3rd-4th = +2, 5th+ = +3.

name: Mirror Image
desc: 3 duplicates. When hit, roll d20 (3=6-10, 2=8-11, 1=11+) to see if duplicate is destroyed instead. Duplicates AC = 10 + Dex.

name: Misty Step
desc: Teleport up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space you can see.

name: Moonbeam
materials: several seeds of any moonseed plant and a piece of opalescent feldspar
desc: 5-ft.-radius cylinder of pale light. Creatures entering or starting inside: Con save or 2d10 radiant, half on save. Shapechangers have disadvantage. Bonus action to move 60 ft. Higher slots: +1d10 per slot.

name: Pass without Trace
materials: ashes from a burned leaf of mistletoe and a sprig of spruce
desc: You and companions within 30 ft. gain +10 to Stealth. Can't be tracked except by magical means.

name: Prayer of Healing
desc: Up to 6 creatures regain 2d8 + spellcasting mod HP. Higher slots: +1d8 per slot.

name: Protection from Poison
desc: Neutralize one poison affecting target, grant advantage on saving throws vs. poison, and resistance to poison damage.

name: Ray of Enfeeblement
desc: Ranged spell attack; target deals only half damage with weapon attacks that use Str. Con save at end of each turn to end.

name: Scorching Ray
desc: 3 rays; each ranged spell attack deals 2d6 fire on hit. Can target same or different creatures. Higher slots: +1 ray per slot.

name: See Invisibility
materials: a pinch of talc and a small sprinkling of powdered silver
desc: See invisible creatures and objects, and into Ethereal Plane within 60 ft.

name: Shatter
materials: a chip of mica
desc: 10-ft.-radius sphere; Con save or 3d8 thunder, half on save. Inorganic creatures have disadvantage. Unattended objects take damage automatically. Higher slots: +1d8 per slot.

name: Silence
desc: 20-ft.-radius sphere. No sound passes through. Creatures inside are deafened. Spells with verbal component can't be cast inside.

name: Spider Climb
materials: a drop of bitumen and a spider
desc: Willing creature can climb on walls/ceilings with full speed, hands free.

name: Spike Growth
materials: seven sharp thorns or seven small twigs, each sharpened to a point
desc: 20-ft.-radius difficult terrain. Moving through costs double and deals 2d4 piercing per 5 ft. traveled. Camouflaged (DC 15 Perception or Survival to spot).

name: Spiritual Weapon
desc: Create weapon; bonus action to move 20 ft. and attack (melee spell attack: 1d8 + spellcasting mod force). Higher slots: +1d8 per 2 slot levels.

name: Suggestion
materials: a snake's tongue and either a bit of honeycomb or a drop of sweet oil
desc: Wis save or carry out reasonable 1-2 sentence course of action. Ends if clearly harmful. Does not apply to creatures immune to charm.

name: Web
materials: a bit of spiderweb
desc: 20-ft.-cube of sticky strands (must anchor to two solid masses). Difficult terrain. Str save or restrained (repeat each turn). Flammable.

name: Zone of Truth
desc: 15-ft.-radius sphere. Cha save or can't deliberately lie (but can remain silent). You know which creatures are affected.

name: Animate Dead
materials: a drop of blood, a piece of flesh, and a pinch of bone dust
desc: Create undead skeleton or zombie from corpse/bones. Obeys commands for 24 hours. Higher slots: +2 undead per slot.

name: Bestow Curse
desc: Melee spell attack; Wis save or cursed. Choose: disadvantage on chosen ability checks/saves, disadvantage on attacks vs. you, Wis save or waste action, or extra 1d8 necrotic when you hit. Higher slots: duration (4th=10min no conc, 5th=8h, 7th=24h, 9th=until dispelled).

name: Blink
desc: At end of each turn, roll d20: 11+, step into Ethereal Plane until your next turn (invisible, incorporeal).

name: Call Lightning
desc: Storm cloud 100-ft. radius. Action: lightning bolt (5-ft. radius, Dex save or 3d10 lightning, half on save). Higher slots: +1d10 per slot.

name: Clairvoyance
materials: a focus worth at least 100 gp (jeweled horn for hearing or eye for seeing)
desc: Create invisible sensor at known location within range. See or hear through sensor.

name: Conjure Animals
desc: Summon fey spirits as beasts: 1 CR 2, 2 CR 1, 4 CR 1/2, or 8 CR 1/4. Higher slots: double beasts per 2 slot levels.

name: Counterspell
desc: Interrupt spell of 3rd level or lower (auto). Higher spells: ability check DC 10 + spell level. Higher slots: auto-counter up to slot level.

name: Create Food and Water
desc: Create 45 lb. of food and 30 gallons of water. Serves 15 humanoids or 5 steeds for 24 hours.

name: Daylight
desc: Bright light in 60-ft.-radius sphere; dim 60 ft. more. Dispels darkness spells of 3rd level or lower. Sunlight sensitivity applies.

name: Dispel Magic
desc: End one spell of 3rd level or lower (auto). Higher spells: ability check DC 10 + spell level. Higher slots: auto-end up to slot level.

name: Fear
materials: a white feather or the heart of a hen
desc: Wis save or frightened. Frightened creature drops held items, must Dash away. Repeat save each turn when can't see you.

name: Fireball
materials: a tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur
desc: 20-ft.-radius sphere; Dex save or 8d6 fire, half on save. Higher slots: +1d6 per slot.

name: Fly
materials: a wing or feather from any bird
desc: Touch willing creature; flying speed 60 ft. Higher slots: +1 target per slot.

name: Gaseous Form
materials: a bit of gauze and a wisp of smoke
desc: Willing creature becomes cloud of mist. Fly 10 ft., hover. Resistance to nonmagical damage. Can enter spaces other creatures can't. Can't attack, cast, or speak.

name: Glyph of Warding
materials: incense and powdered diamond worth at least 200 gp
desc: Inscribe glyph on surface. Trigger condition (creature type, item moved). Effect: explosive rune (5d8 damage, Dex save half) or spell stored at 3rd level or lower.

name: Haste
materials: a shaving of licorice root
desc: Willing creature: double speed, +2 AC, advantage on Dex saves, one extra action (attack, Dash, Disengage, Hide, Use). When ends: creature can't move or take actions for 1 turn.

name: Hypnotic Pattern
materials: a glowing stick of incense or a crystal vial filled with phosphorescent material
desc: 30-ft.-cube of twisting patterns; Wis save or charmed (incapacitated). Creature that leaves spell area or is shaken out of trance is no longer affected.

name: Lightning Bolt
materials: a bit of fur and a rod of amber, crystal, or glass
desc: 100-ft.-line, 5 ft. wide; Dex save or 8d6 lightning, half on save. Higher slots: +1d6 per slot.

name: Magic Circle
materials: holy water or powdered silver and iron worth at least 100 gp
desc: 10-ft.-radius, 20-ft.-tall cylinder. Choose creature type (celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, undead): can't enter (Cha save); can't charm, frighten, or possess creatures inside.

name: Major Image
materials: a bit of fleece
desc: 20-ft.-cube illusion with sound, smell, temperature. Investigation check vs. spell save DC. Higher slots: 6th = permanent without concentration.

name: Mass Healing Word
desc: Up to 6 creatures each regain 1d4 + spellcasting mod HP. Higher slots: +1d4 per slot.

name: Nondetection
materials: a pinch of diamond dust worth 25 gp
desc: Target can't be targeted by divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

name: Plant Growth
desc: 1 action: 100-ft. radius overgrows; difficult terrain (4× movement cost). 8 hours: enrich land for 1 year.

name: Protection from Energy
desc: Willing creature has resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (your choice).

name: Remove Curse
desc: End all curses on one creature or object. Ends Bestow Curse, removes attunement to cursed items.

name: Revivify
materials: diamonds worth 300 gp
desc: Touch creature dead no more than 1 minute. Returns with 1 HP. Can't restore lost body parts. No effect on undead.

name: Sending
materials: a short piece of fine copper wire
desc: Send 25-word message to familiar creature (any plane). They can reply with 25 words. Creature knows you are the sender.

name: Slow
materials: a drop of molasses
desc: Up to 6 creatures in 40-ft. cube; Wis save or: half speed, -2 AC/Dex saves, can't use reactions, one action or bonus action per turn, no multi-attack. Repeat save each turn.

name: Speak with Dead
materials: burning incense
desc: Corpse answers 5 questions truthfully but only knows what it knew in life. Answers are brief.

name: Spirit Guardians
materials: a holy symbol
desc: Spirits surround you. Enemies in area: Wis save or 3d8 radiant/necrotic (half on save); difficult terrain. Higher slots: +1d8 per slot.

name: Stinking Cloud
materials: a rotten egg or several skunk cabbage leaves
desc: 20-ft.-radius cloud, heavily obscured. Con save or spend action retching; can't attack or cast.

name: Tongues
materials: a small clay model of a ziggurat
desc: Touched creature understands any spoken language and can speak any language it knows to be understood by any creature that has a language.

name: Vampiric Touch
desc: Melee spell attack; 3d6 necrotic. Gain HP equal to half damage dealt. Repeat attack each turn with bonus action. Higher slots: +1d6 per slot.

name: Water Breathing
materials: a short reed or piece of straw
desc: Up to 10 willing creatures breathe underwater for 24 hours without drowning.

name: Wind Wall
materials: a tiny fan and a feather of exotic origin
desc: Wall of strong wind up to 50 ft. long, 15 ft. high, 1 ft. thick. Creatures passing through: Str save or 3d8 bludgeoning, half on save. Tiny/smaller creatures can't pass. Disperses gas.

name: Arcane Eye
materials: a bit of bat fur
desc: Invisible magical eye that moves 30 ft. (or 15 ft. through solid surfaces). Darkvision 30 ft. Action to move. Can't attack or cast.

name: Banishment
materials: an item distasteful to the target
desc: Cha save or banished. Native plane: temporary demiplane (returns when spell ends). Other plane: banished home permanently if concentration held 1 minute. Higher slots: +1 target per slot.

name: Blight
desc: Con save or 8d8 necrotic, half on save. Plants save with disadvantage, no save for plant creatures not undead. Higher slots: +1d8 per slot.

name: Compulsion
desc: Wis save or compelled to move in your chosen direction on its turn. Doesn't move into obvious hazard. Can still attack.

name: Confusion
materials: three nut shells
desc: Wis save or confused (10-ft. radius). Roll d10 each turn: wander, do nothing, attack random, act normally. Higher slots: radius +5 ft. per slot.

name: Control Water
materials: a drop of water and a pinch of dust
desc: 100-ft. cube of water: flood, part, redirect, or whirlpool (Str save or 2d8 bludgeoning + restrained).

name: Death Ward
desc: If target would drop to 0 HP, instead drops to 1 HP and spell ends. If target would die from massive damage with 0 HP, spell ends and damage is negated.

name: Dimension Door
desc: Teleport to any location within 500 ft. that you can visualize. Can bring one willing Medium or smaller creature. If destination occupied: fail, 4d6 force damage.

name: Divination
materials: incense and a sacrificial offering appropriate to your religion worth at least 25 gp
desc: Receive truthful reply about a specific event within the next 7 days. Reply may be cryptic. Accuracy decreases with repeated uses.

name: Dominate Beast
desc: Wis save or charmed. Use action to issue commands (telepathically). Repeat save each time it takes damage. Higher slots: duration (5th=10min, 6th=1h, 7th+=8h).

name: Freedom of Movement
materials: a leather strap, bound around the arm or a similar appendage
desc: Ignore difficult terrain, spells/effects can't reduce speed or paralyze/restrain. Swim at full speed. Move freely underwater.

name: Greater Invisibility
desc: Target becomes invisible. Remains invisible even when attacking or casting spells.

name: Guardian of Faith
desc: Large spectral guardian. Hostile creatures within 10 ft.: Dex save or 20 radiant (half on save). 60 total damage then disappears.

name: Ice Storm
materials: a pinch of dust and a few drops of water
desc: 20-ft.-radius, 40-ft.-high cylinder; Dex save or 2d8 bludgeoning + 4d6 cold, half on save. Area becomes difficult terrain. Higher slots: +1d8 per slot.

name: Phantasmal Killer
desc: Wis save or frightened; 4d10 psychic at end of each turn (Wis save to end on success). Higher slots: +1d10 per slot.

name: Polymorph
materials: a caterpillar cocoon
desc: Wis save or transform into beast (CR ≤ level, CR 0 if willing). Uses beast's stats. Drops to 0 in beast form: reverts with original HP. No spells in beast form.

name: Stone Shape
materials: soft clay, which must be worked into roughly the desired shape of the stone object
desc: Reshape Medium or smaller stone or stone section of a larger surface (up to 5 cu. ft.).

name: Stoneskin
materials: diamond dust worth 100 gp
desc: Willing creature gains resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

name: Wall of Fire
materials: a small piece of phosphorus
desc: 60-ft.-long, 20-ft.-high, 1-ft.-thick wall (or 20-ft.-diameter ring). One side deals 5d8 fire to creatures that end turn within 10 ft. or pass through. Higher slots: +1d8 per slot.

name: Animate Objects
desc: Animate up to 10 nonmagical objects. Small: +2 atk, 1d4+4 dmg. Medium: +2, 2d6+2. Large: +2, 2d8+2; Huge: +2, 2d12+2. Bonus action to command. Higher slots: +2 objects per slot.

name: Cloudkill
desc: 20-ft.-radius sphere of poison fog (heavily obscured). Con save or 5d8 poison, half on save. Moves 10 ft. away from you each round. Higher slots: +1d8 per slot.

name: Commune
materials: incense and a vial of holy or unholy water
desc: Ask 3 yes/no questions of your deity. True answers (may be 'unclear'). Once per day; failure after subsequent casts.

name: Cone of Cold
materials: a small crystal or glass cone
desc: Con save or 8d8 cold, half on save. Killed targets become frozen statues (fragile). Higher slots: +1d8 per slot.

name: Conjure Elemental
materials: burning incense (air), soft clay (earth), sulfur and phosphorus (fire), or water and sand (water)
desc: Summon elemental of CR 5 or lower from appropriate element. Hostility toward you if you lose concentration. Higher slots: +1 CR per slot.

name: Contact Other Plane
desc: Contact planar entity; 5 yes/no questions. Int DC 15 save or insane for 1d10 × 10 hours (Feeblemind effect). Prepare cures first.

name: Creation
materials: a tiny piece of matter of the same type of the item you plan to create
desc: Create nonliving vegetable matter (1d day) or mineral/crystal (12 hours) up to 5-ft. cube. Duration varies by material. Higher slots: +5-ft. cube per slot.

name: Dispel Evil and Good
materials: holy water or powdered silver and iron
desc: Celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, undead: disadvantage on attacks vs. you. Action to dismiss (Cha save) or break enchantment on a touched creature.

name: Dominate Person
desc: Humanoid; Wis save or charmed and under your control. Repeat save each time damaged. Higher slots: duration (6th=10min, 7th=1h, 8th+=8h).

name: Flame Strike
materials: pinch of sulfur
desc: 10-ft.-radius, 40-ft.-high column. Dex save or 4d6 fire + 4d6 radiant, half on save. Higher slots: +1d6 each per slot.

name: Geas
desc: Wis save or compelled/forbidden to perform stated service (not obviously deadly). 5d10 psychic per day if violated. Higher slots: duration (7th=1 year, 9th=permanent).

name: Greater Restoration
materials: diamond dust worth at least 100 gp
desc: Reduce exhaustion by 1, end charmed/petrified, restore HP max reduction, end one curse or attunement.

name: Hold Monster
materials: a small, straight piece of iron
desc: Any creature; Wis save or paralyzed. Repeat save each turn. Higher slots: +1 target per slot.

name: Insect Plague
materials: a few grains of sugar, some kernels of grain, and a smear of fat
desc: 20-ft.-radius sphere of biting insects; heavily obscured. Con save or 4d10 piercing, half on save. Higher slots: +1d10 per slot.

name: Legend Lore
materials: incense worth at least 250 gp and four ivory strips worth at least 50 gp each
desc: Receive lore about a legendary person, place, or object. Vague for passing knowledge, specific for direct experience.

name: Mass Cure Wounds
desc: Up to 6 creatures each regain 3d8 + spellcasting mod HP. No effect on undead/constructs. Higher slots: +1d8 per slot.

name: Mislead
desc: Become invisible and create illusory double. Bonus action to move double and speak through it. See and hear through double's senses.

name: Modify Memory
desc: Wis save or charmed (incapacitated); alter one memory from past 24 hours. Higher slots: further back in time.

name: Passwall
materials: a pinch of sesame seeds
desc: Create a passage in a wooden, plaster, or stone wall up to 20 ft. deep × 5 ft. wide × 8 ft. tall.

name: Planar Binding
materials: a jewel worth at least 1,000 gp
desc: Cha save to bind summoned celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend for duration. Bound creature must obey your commands. Higher slots: duration.

name: Raise Dead
materials: a diamond worth at least 500 gp
desc: Creature dead no more than 10 days. Penalty: -4 to attacks, saves, ability checks (1d4 per short/long rest to recover). Elves can refuse.

name: Reincarnate
materials: rare oils and unguents worth at least 1,000 gp
desc: Dead creature (dead ≤10 days) returns in a new body (roll d100 for species). Retains memories, class, and abilities.

name: Scrying
materials: a focus worth at least 1,000 gp
desc: Wis save (modified by familiarity) or sensor appears near target. You see/hear through sensor.

name: Telekinesis
desc: Move up to 1,000 lb. or one creature (Str save) up to 30 ft. per round. Can restrain or crush. Opposed by Str.

name: Tree Stride
desc: Enter a living tree and emerge from another same-species tree within 500 ft. Uses 5 ft. of movement.

name: Wall of Force
materials: a pinch of powder made by crushing a clear gemstone
desc: Invisible wall (10 panels, 10 ft. × 10 ft. each, flat or dome). Immune to damage, impenetrable, can't be dispelled. Disintegrate destroys it.

name: Wall of Stone
materials: a small block of granite
desc: Ten 10-ft. × 10-ft. panels, 6 in. thick. Each has AC 5, 30 HP. Creatures in space must Dex save or be trapped.

name: Blade Barrier
desc: Wall of whirling blades (100 ft. long, 20 ft. high, 5 ft. thick, or ring 60 ft. diameter). Dex save or 6d10 slashing, half on save. Difficult terrain.

name: Chain Lightning
materials: a bit of fur, a piece of amber, glass, or a crystal rod, and three silver pins
desc: Primary target + up to 3 secondary targets within 30 ft. of each other; Dex save or 10d8 lightning, half on save. Higher slots: +1 secondary target per slot.

name: Circle of Death
materials: the powder of a crushed black pearl worth at least 500 gp
desc: 60-ft.-radius sphere; Con save or 8d6 necrotic, half on save. Higher slots: +2d6 per slot.

name: Create Undead
materials: one clay pot filled with grave dirt, one clay pot filled with brackish water, and one 150 gp black onyx stone per corpse
desc: Create up to 3 ghouls from corpses. Obey you for 24 hours (order to continue). Higher slots: more powerful undead.

name: Disintegrate
materials: a lodestone and a pinch of dust
desc: Dex save or 10d6+40 force. Reduced to dust at 0 HP. Works on Wall of Force. Higher slots: +3d6+10 per slot.

name: Eyebite
desc: Bonus action each turn: Asleep (Wis save or unconscious until damaged), Panicked (Wis save or frightened, must Dash), Sickened (Con save or disadvantage on attacks/ability checks).

name: Flesh to Stone
materials: a pinch of lime, water, and earth
desc: Con save or restrained; 3 failures total = petrified. Successes reset if maintained. Greater Restoration reverses.

name: Globe of Invulnerability
materials: a glass or crystal bead that shatters when the spell ends
desc: Spells of 5th level and lower can't affect targets inside the globe. Higher slots: +1 level per slot.

name: Harm
desc: Con save or 14d6 necrotic (max HP reduced by same amount for 1 hour). Half on save, no max HP reduction. Can't reduce below 1 HP.

name: Heal
desc: Target regains 70 HP and ends blindness, deafness, and disease. Higher slots: +10 HP per slot.

name: Heroes' Feast
materials: a gem-encrusted bowl worth at least 1,000 gp
desc: Up to 12 creatures feast; immunity to poison/fear, advantage on Wis saves, max HP +2d10 for 24 hours.

name: Mass Suggestion
materials: a snake's tongue and either a bit of honeycomb or a drop of sweet oil
desc: Up to 12 creatures; Wis save or follow reasonable suggestion. Higher slots: duration (7th=10 days, 8th=30 days, 9th=366 days).

name: Move Earth
materials: an iron blade and a small bag containing a mixture of soils — clay, loam, and sand
desc: Reshape terrain (40-ft. cube): excavate, raise, sink, or create sloped ground. Takes 10 minutes to shift 40 ft. × 40 ft.

name: Sunbeam
materials: a magnifying glass
desc: 60-ft.-line; Con save or 6d8 radiant + blind 1 minute, half no blind on save. Undead/oozes: disadvantage. Dispels magical darkness. Action each turn to recast.

name: True Seeing
materials: an ointment of mushroom powder, saffron, and fat worth at least 25 gp
desc: Target gains truesight and can see through secret doors and into the Ethereal Plane, all out to 120 ft.

name: Wall of Ice
materials: a small piece of quartz
desc: Up to 10 10-ft. panels of ice (1-ft. thick). Pass through: 5d6 cold and damage as much again in ice panels. Con save or AC reduces by 1d4 from ice encasement.

name: Word of Recall
desc: You and up to 5 willing creatures teleport to your designated sanctuary. Sanctuary set by casting this spell at the location.

name: Divine Word
desc: Creatures you choose: 50 HP → deafened 1 min; 40 HP → blinded 10 min; 30 HP → stunned 1 hour; 20 HP → killed instantly. Celestials/elementals/fey/fiends: banished if fails save.

name: Etherealness
desc: Enter Ethereal Plane. Move through objects; see into material plane (limited). Spells don't cross planes. Higher slots: +3 willing creatures per slot.

name: Finger of Death
desc: Con save or 7d8+30 necrotic, half on save. Humanoid killed by this spell rises as zombie under your permanent control.

name: Fire Storm
desc: Up to 10 10-ft. cubes; Dex save or 7d10 fire, half on save. Nonmagical plants automatically fail. Choose whether plant life is unaffected.

name: Forcecage
materials: ruby dust worth 1,500 gp
desc: Cage of force (20-ft. cube with bars or solid box). Creatures inside can't leave by any means short of teleportation or plane shift with Cha save.

name: Regenerate
materials: a prayer wheel and holy water
desc: Target regains 4d8+15 HP. For 1 hour: regain 1 HP per round start. Severed limbs reattach (or regrow in 2 minutes) if held to stump.

name: Resurrection
materials: a diamond worth at least 1,000 gp
desc: Dead up to 100 years. Returns with 1 HP, ends curses and magical diseases. Penalties reduce over 1d4 days. No lost body parts.

name: Reverse Gravity
materials: a lodestone and iron filings
desc: 50-ft.-radius, 100-ft.-high cylinder. Gravity reverses; creatures Dex save or fall upward 100 ft. At top: suspended. When ends: fall back down.

name: Symbol
materials: mercury, phosphorus, and powdered diamond and opal worth at least 1,000 gp
desc: Inscribe magical symbol. Choose effect: Death, Discord, Fear, Hopelessness, Insanity, Pain, Sleep, Stunning. Triggered by conditions you set.

name: Teleport
desc: Teleport up to 8 willing creatures to familiar destination on same plane. Roll for accuracy; off target, similar area, or mishap based on familiarity.

name: Antimagic Field
materials: a pinch of powdered iron or iron filings
desc: 10-ft.-radius sphere suppresses all magic (spells can't be cast, items cease to function, summoned creatures vanish). You are also suppressed.

name: Clone
materials: a diamond worth at least 1,000 gp and at least 1 cubic inch of the flesh of the creature cloned
desc: Grow a duplicate body in 120 days. When original dies, soul transfers to clone. Clone has original's class levels but none of original's equipment.

name: Control Weather
materials: burning incense and bits of earth and wood mixed in water
desc: Alter weather in 5-mile radius: precipitation, wind, temperature. Takes 1d4 × 10 minutes to shift one stage in each category.

name: Demiplane
desc: Create a door to an extradimensional space (30-ft. cube). Multiple castings can connect demiplanes. Door is visible to all.

name: Dominate Monster
desc: Any creature; Wis save or charmed and under your control. Repeat save when damaged. Higher slots: 9th = 8 hours.

name: Earthquake
materials: a pinch of dirt, a piece of rock, and a lump of clay
desc: 100-ft.-radius difficult terrain. Con save or prone (DC 15 to concentrate). Buildings may collapse (5d6 bludgeoning per round inside). Fissures open (Dex save or 10 ft. deep).

name: Feeblemind
materials: a handful of clay, crystal, glass, or mineral spheres
desc: Int save or Int and Cha drop to 1. Can't cast spells, activate magic items, or understand language. Greater Restoration or similar to end.

name: Mind Blank
desc: Immune to psychic damage, divination spells, and the charmed condition for 24 hours.

name: Power Word Stun
desc: If target has ≤150 HP: stunned. Con save at end of each turn to end effect. No save allowed initially.

name: Sunburst
materials: fire and a piece of sunstone
desc: 60-ft.-radius bright light. Con save or 12d6 radiant + blinded 1 minute, half no blind on save. Undead/oozes: disadvantage. Dispels magical darkness.

name: Astral Projection
materials: a jacinth worth at least 1,000 gp and a carved bar of silver worth at least 100 gp per creature
desc: Up to 8 willing creatures project into the Astral Plane. Astral body connected by silver cord. Cord cut = death.

name: Foresight
materials: a hummingbird feather
desc: Touched creature: can't be surprised, advantage on attacks/saves/ability checks, all attacks against it have disadvantage.

name: Gate
materials: a diamond worth at least 5,000 gp
desc: Open circular portal (5–20 ft. diameter) to other plane. Named specific deity/demon can be summoned (Int contest to compel service).

name: Imprisonment
materials: a vellum depiction or a carved statuette of the target worth at least 500 gp
desc: Wis save or trapped indefinitely. Choose: buried in stasis, floating orb, chained to spot, slumbering miniature, hedged prison. Freedom or wish to end.

name: Mass Heal
desc: Up to any number of creatures regain HP total of 700 (distribute as you choose). Also ends blinded, deafened, and diseased.

name: Meteor Swarm
desc: Four 40-ft.-radius spheres at different points; Dex save or 20d6 fire + 20d6 bludgeoning, half on save.

name: Power Word Heal
desc: Touch creature; regains all HP. Ends charmed, frightened, paralyzed, stunned. If prone, can stand up.

name: Power Word Kill
desc: If target has ≤100 HP: it dies. No save.

name: Shapechange
materials: a jade circlet worth at least 1,500 gp
desc: Transform into any creature (CR ≤ your level). Retain personality, memories, and mental ability scores. Change form multiple times as action.

name: Time Stop
desc: Stop time; take 1d4+1 turns. Other creatures don't move/act. Ends immediately if you affect another creature or object.

name: True Polymorph
materials: a drop of mercury, a dollop of gum arabic, and a wisp of smoke
desc: Transform creature or object permanently (if maintained for 1 hour). Creature into creature or object, object into creature. Same CR restrictions as Polymorph but more flexible.

name: True Resurrection
materials: a sprinkle of holy water and diamonds worth at least 25,000 gp
desc: Dead creature (up to 200 years ago, not undead). Returns at full HP. If body destroyed, new body formed. Restores all lost body parts.

name: Wish
desc: Duplicate any spell of 8th level or lower; or alter reality. Stress: Str drops to 3, 33% chance Wish never works again, 1d10 days of exhaustion.
